sections.heading: Search and Information Retrieval with Edit Distance
Search and Information Retrieval with Edit Distance
sections.evidence: This section examines how Levenshtein distance and related edit-distance methods are used in search and information retrieval, from fuzzy matching and spelling correction to candidate generation, thresholding, indexing, and large-scale approximate retrieval.
paragraphs: This section examines how Levenshtein distance and related edit-distance methods are used in search and information retrieval, from fuzzy matching and spelling correction to candidate generation, thresholding, indexing, and large-scale approximate retrieval.

01 Spell & Query Correction with Edit Distance: Models, Ranking & Search A rigorous guide to spelling and query correction with Levenshtein distance: candidate generation, noisy-channel models, context, query logs, ranking, Unicode, and modern neural methods. Article · 26 min read

02 Fuzzy Search at Scale: Indexing, Filtering & Exact Verification A rigorous guide to scalable fuzzy search with edit distance: q-gram indexes, filters, Levenshtein automata, partitioning, top-k search, distributed systems, and exact verification. Article · 51 min read

03 Fuzzy Search with Edit Distance: Algorithms, Thresholds & Ranking A rigorous guide to fuzzy search with Levenshtein distance: approximate matching, substring search, thresholds, ranking, automata, candidate generation, Unicode, and failure modes. Article · 36 min read
